source_clock.source_index: s starts at 0 and advances by one per complete 1536-sample source frame
source_clock.eof: no codec or metadata-only flush; pending writers are discarded on finalize

source_order: collect complete F13 ID11/ID1/ID2/ID14 ready receipts for this source generation
only after all four are ready, push/pop staged queues in order [11,1,2,14]

for s=0/1, suppress F13 EMDF serialization/complexity/carrier validation and pass typed ABSENT_PUBLISHED_PAYLOAD_V1 to F12; F12 still builds a full 4096-byte scratch frame, writes keyless tail fields, and computes/verifies E-AC-3 CRC16
for s>=2, serialize popped bodies in EMDF order [11,14,2,1], apply the fixed carriage mode and F14K checksums, parse same-container complexity/carrier inputs
build a complete F12 4096-byte candidate from same-source audio, block plans, BSI and EMDF payload
for s=0/1, commit successful timer/queue/codec source state without an AU append; do not skip the codec frame or its CRC16
for s>=2, append exactly 4096 bytes to the staging stream at offset (s-2)*4096; partial writes loop until complete; fsync before logical/durable AU ledger commit
after final expected source/AU counts, fsync staging, atomically rename to final path, and fsync the parent directory

atomicity_and_failures.owner: F15 selected keyless publication root coordinates F13, F12 and public integrity staged proposals
atomicity_and_failures.success: one source transaction commit after suppression gate or durable append as appropriate
atomicity_and_failures.failure: no partial AU becomes logical output; staged queue/timer/codec/integrity proposals are discarded; programme attempt retires and requires full restart
atomicity_and_failures.short_write: zero progress or error retires attempt; write offset is attempt-local and logical AU count is unchanged until full 4096-byte write and flush succeed
atomicity_and_failures.no_claim: no power-loss transactional guarantee across filesystem, in-memory state and other owners beyond the explicit F15 model contract

readiness_boundary.F12 supplied-fixture boundary: local review PASS; four 4096-byte fixture frames and CRC residuals checked
readiness_boundary.cross_module_production: PARTIAL; F06/F08/F13 production inputs remain separate gates

authority_note: Use already approved CODEC-SOURCE-TRANSACTION-KEYLESS-PUBLICATION-V1 for precise flush/readback/fail-stop ordering and main Q+4 callbacks; 4249/4247 is one programme example only. Physical partial progress is possible even when logical publication fails. Post-rename failure must not imply file rollback.
